exclusion_reason: Implemented but red because there is no video decode path — the proprietary FMV codecs (Bink, Smacker) stay refused by identity and no redistributable decoder is wired, and seek/pause are not driven end to end from a running decoder — so the timeline has no real frames to present. The A/V-sync core exists generically in lib/audio.mjs: createFmvTimeline locks the picture to the one audio master clock (the shown frame derives from that clock), counts the frames a stall skipped as dropped rather than playing them late, clamps to the last frame, and resolves subtitle cues by time (end-exclusive), which the present path carries alongside the frame.
promotion_trigger: Promote when the FMV fixture holds the drift budget across seek and pause with on-time cue.
expected_failing_assertion: No redistributable video decoder is wired and proprietary FMV codecs stay refused, so the timeline has no decoded frames to hold against the drift budget across seek and pause.
active_gate_evidence: Two tests prove the sync core: the FMV timeline locks the frame index to the audio master clock, advances on cadence, drops the frames a stall skipped, and clamps to the last frame; and subtitle cues resolve by playback time (end-exclusive) with the present path carrying the active cue. The roadmap keeps proprietary codec refusal in place and the full suite stays green.
procedure: Play the FMV fixture with subtitle cue.
Seek and pause at declared point and measure drift.
Assert cue timing within the declared budget.
pass_criterion: Cue fire on time after seek.
